name: vn-test
description: Playwright-shaped end-to-end testing for vue-native apps, as a library for `bun test`.

comments.dependencies: There are NONE, on purpose — the same rule devtools/ctl.ts follows. `bun test` is the runner, `bun:test` ships with bun, and the wire is node:net + node:child_process. A test harness that needs its own `bun install` to have run is a harness that cannot be the first thing you reach for after a fresh clone.
